zoe: quick note from local evals: new candidate rwd-v4-int4 shows ~2.3x cost savings and P95 latency down ~45ms but code multi-file BLEU down ~1.8% (N=2.2k). need to decide canary gates.

raj: paste top-line deltas pls.

zoe: P50 -18ms, P95 -45ms, cost -57%, doc-mrr -0.6% abs, qa EM -0.4% abs, code BLEU -1.8% abs.

marta: code slice concern. sample size and CI?

zoe: code N=2200, 95% CI ~±0.6% (BLEU). failures cluster on multi-file imports and long helper truncation. added two reproducibles.

sam: ops smoke ok?

opsbot: staging smoke green, no OOMs, KV hit rate normal.

raj: proposal: phased canary 5% x24h -> 25% x12h -> promote. auto-fallback if overall fidelity drop >1.0% abs or hallucination up >0.5% abs or P95 latency +25ms.

marta: for code-slice, prefer escalation-first: if code delta in (1.0%,3.0%) open 1h human review instead of immediate fallback; >3% => auto-fallback. ensure we capture full request/response for 1k code examples.

zoe: implemented in rollout snippet, will anonymize PII. also add variance (token logprob) soft-alert if uplift >15% (no auto-fallback).

sam: I'll add dashboard tile and alert (ETA 6h).

deploy-bot: rollout PR CI passed; canary scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

zoe: action items: PR with repros + artifacts, ops to pin canary capacity, marta/raj on-call for review window. ping when PR live. :rocket:
